Performance Assessment Companion

Official assessment question 01

Role Performance

How consistently did I meet the quality and delivery standards expected in my role?

How to rate this section

Consider performance across the core responsibilities of your role and relative to the expectations of your level. Reflect on quality, timeliness, reliability, and consistency across the full assessment period. Use examples that represent your overall performance rather than a single project or event. If you lead people, reflect more than your own output. Consider how well you built a collaborative, inclusive, high-performing team through talent development, performance management, engagement, retention, and results.

Complete your profile to load level-specific guidance.

Evidence

Link evidence from your library to this section. Evidence is shared — it won't be duplicated.

No evidence in your library yet. Add evidence to link it here.

Before selecting a rating, reflect on:

  • ·What responsibilities did I perform consistently across the full period?
  • ·Where did my work meet quality and delivery expectations?
  • ·What evidence reflects performance across the period, not just recent months?
  • ·Where did I need rework, escalation, or additional support?
  • ·Which examples best reflect my selected level?
  • ·Am I mistaking visibility, effort, polish, tenure, or potential for sustained impact?

Self-assessment rating

Review your evidence first. No rating is pre-selected. The rating you choose is your judgment — this tool does not recommend or validate a rating.

Select your self-assessment rating

Review your evidence before selecting a rating. No rating is pre-selected.

Draft response

Write your response in your own words, using the evidence you've gathered. This is what you'll copy into the official system.
